{{Top|leg}}
A '''holobio''' was a form of entertainment created using [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] technology. As the name implied, the purpose of a holobio was to present the life story of a real person.<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>

Former [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] bought a holobio of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] as his [[Return (Alderaanian)|Return]] gift to his [[Death/Legends|deceased]]  brother [[Skoloc Celchu]].<ref name="bacta" />
